descriptions.ardudeck-hud: Glanceable ArduDeck-styled flight screen: big honest numbers, armed/mode bar, live STATUSTEXT ticker, and a diagnostic ladder that tells you exactly why telemetry is missing instead of "no telemetry". Config is generated from your connected vehicle. All color radios; layouts rescale to the screen. B&W radios get a dense telemetry script, installed and wired to a telemetry screen for you.
descriptions.yaapu-telemetry: Full ArduPilot telemetry widget: HUD, flight modes, GPS, battery, STATUSTEXT messages with voice alerts. Works over ELRS 4.x MAVLink and CRSF passthrough.

mainIndex.keychainNoticeDetail:
ArduDeck encrypts the sensitive data you enter - AI provider API keys, map service keys and connection tokens - and keeps the encryption key in your macOS keychain, the same vault Safari uses for your passwords.

Because macOS guards that vault, it may ask once whether ArduDeck can access "ardudeck Safe Storage". That is ArduDeck unlocking its own encryption key, nothing else.

Click "Always Allow" and macOS will not ask again. Nothing is read from other apps and nothing ever leaves this computer.

mavlinkCalibration.compassFailedReason: Compass calibration failed: {{reason}}. Move away from metal/magnets/wiring and try again.
mavlinkCalibration.compassNotConverging: Compass calibration is not converging. Check the compass is healthy (prearm "Compass not healthy" means it is not), move away from metal/magnets/wiring, and rotate through all axes. If this FC has no working compass, disable it (COMPASS_ENABLE=0). Stabilize does not need one.
mavlinkCalibration.compassRefusedStart: The vehicle refused to start: it only calibrates compasses that are switched on AND reporting. Check the Compasses card, at least one must be In use and healthy. Power the vehicle from its battery, not USB alone.
mavlinkCalibration.fcBusy: Flight controller is busy. Disarm, wait a few seconds, and try again.
mavlinkCalibration.hintAccel: Hold each position still on a firm surface and try again.
mavlinkCalibration.hintCompass: Move away from metal, magnets and wiring, then try again.
mavlinkCalibration.magCalGpsFailed: Calibration failed. Ensure GPS has 3D lock and the heading is correct, then try again.
mavlinkCalibration.magCalInProgress: Large Vehicle MagCal already in progress
mavlinkCalibration.noCompassCalibrated: No compass calibrated. {{failed}}. Move away from metal, magnets and wiring, and try again.
mavlinkCalibration.noResponse: Flight controller did not respond. Check the connection and try again.
mavlinkCalibration.notReady: Flight controller is not ready. Wait a few seconds after connecting and try again.
mavlinkCalibration.partialSuccess: {{done}} of {{expected}} calibrated and saved. {{failed}} was not, and keeps its previous calibration.
mavlinkCalibration.positionConfirmFailed: Failed to send position confirmation - ensure FC is connected

mavlinkCalibration.sendFinishFailed: Failed to send finish command - ensure FC is connected

scriptBundle.climbRtlDescription: Climbs the vehicle in place to a safe altitude before the FC switches to RTL for the actual return. Solves the "RTL into a tree" problem when current altitude is below RTL_ALT or the home path is blocked.
scriptBundle.heapWhy: Scripts need at least 64 KiB of heap.
scriptBundle.landAtDescription: Flies to the clicked lat/lon at the vehicle's current altitude, then switches to LAND mode. Solves the "ArduCopter NAV_LAND ignores lat/lon and just descends in place" problem by repositioning first.
scriptBundle.orbitDescription: Orbits a target lat/lon at a chosen radius and altitude in GUIDED mode. Anchored to live telemetry, so link drops do not desync the orbit. Optional revolutions count: 0 = indefinite, N = stop and hover after N full circles.
scriptBundle.revealDescription: Cinematic pull-back: vehicle retreats from its current position along the away-from-target bearing while climbing, yaw locked to the clicked target throughout. The "castle reveal" shot.
scriptBundle.scrEnableWhy: Lua scripting must be enabled on the autopilot.
scriptBundle.spiralDescription: Orbits a target lat/lon while continuously climbing or descending toward a target altitude at a chosen rate. Once the target altitude is reached, holds the orbit indefinitely. Useful for clearing obstacles before RTL or controlled descent into landing zones.
scriptBundle.strafeDescription: Cinematic dolly pass: vehicle flies along an axis perpendicular to the target-to-vehicle bearing at a chosen offset, yaw locked to the clicked target. Picks the side of the target the vehicle is already on so the approach is short.
scriptBundle.watchtowerDescription: Hovers at a clicked point and slowly rotates yaw for a panoramic survey. Useful for "what is around me?" site checks or quick 360° captures.

scriptInstaller.noHeartbeat:
Script uploaded but no heartbeat ({{name}}) received within {{seconds}}s. Possible causes:
  • SCR_ENABLE is not 1 (preflight should have caught this)
  • The script crashed on load - check the FC's STATUSTEXT messages
  • The FC didn't actually reboot/reload the script subsystem
  • SITL didn't restart cleanly

scriptInstaller.versionMismatch: Expected v{{expected}} but FC reports v{{observed}}. Possibly an older script is still loaded.

streamClassifier.asciiSuggestion: The device is in a logging/boot mode or this is its debug output port. Check its mode and pick the telemetry port.
streamClassifier.asciiSummary: This port is printing text (a debug console), not telemetry.
streamClassifier.crsfElrsSuggestion: Switch the module to MAVLink link mode. ArduDeck can do this for you from the ELRS Radio Setup card - the receiver must be powered off while the mode changes.
streamClassifier.crsfElrsSummary: This device is speaking CRSF link statistics - it is an ELRS radio module in Normal link mode, not MAVLink.
streamClassifier.crsfSuggestion: This looks like an RC receiver feed. To use it for telemetry, the ELRS link must be in MAVLink mode on both ends.
streamClassifier.crsfSummary: This port is speaking CRSF (RC receiver protocol), not MAVLink.
streamClassifier.gpsSuggestion: Pick a different serial port - this one has a GPS on it.
streamClassifier.gpsSummary: This is a GPS module (NMEA/u-blox output), not a flight controller.
streamClassifier.mavlinkNoHeartbeatSuggestion: The stream may be from a radio or companion device rather than the flight controller, or heavily corrupted. Check that the vehicle is powered and its telemetry port is configured for MAVLink2.
streamClassifier.mavlinkNoHeartbeatSummary: MAVLink telemetry is flowing on this port, but no vehicle heartbeat was accepted.
streamClassifier.mpegtsSuggestion: Use the RTP/UDP camera source - the media engine ingests MPEG-TS directly.
streamClassifier.mpegtsSummary: An MPEG-TS video stream is arriving on this port.
streamClassifier.mspSuggestion: Connect with the MSP option instead, or switch the flight controller port to MAVLink.
streamClassifier.mspSummary: This port is speaking MSP (Betaflight/iNav protocol), not MAVLink.
streamClassifier.rtpSuggestion: The wfb-ng ground station is forwarding video - the OpenIPC/WiFiLink camera source can play it.
streamClassifier.rtpSummary: An RTP video stream is arriving on this port (payload type {{pts}}).
streamClassifier.silentSuggestion: Check power and wiring. If this is a radio module, make sure it is powered and linked; if it is a flight controller, make sure this is the right port.
streamClassifier.silentSummary: The port is completely silent - no data at all.
streamClassifier.unknownSuggestion: This usually means the baud rate is wrong. Try other baud rates (ELRS MAVLink uses 460800, SiK radios 57600, flight controller USB 115200).
streamClassifier.unknownSummary: Data is arriving but it does not match any known protocol.
